Repo line-ending policy (owner call, still open, but the urgent half is CLOSED as of 2026-07-27). The rationale previously recorded here -- 'building on the WSL /mnt/c mount emits CRLF and produces a 3,177-line content-free diff' -- was a wrong diagnosis. The mount was a bystander. The real cause was preprocess-sections.sh trapping a CRLF record's trailing CR *inside* the bold markers it generates (`**Header<CR>**`) and writing that back into the source; a lone CR makes git classify the file as non-text, which silently disables core.autocrlf=input for it, so its CRLF endings then diff against CI's LF blobs on every line. Script fixed at source and the 11 committed occurrences repaired (8a0fd27f), so the phantom-diff symptom is gone and a local build is no longer expected to churn. What remains genuinely open, and is a much weaker case: 50 of 95 section sources still carry CRLF in the working tree, harmless under autocrlf=input but re-armed the moment any future generator does substring surgery on a record. A narrow `.gitattributes` (`*.md text eol=lf`) would remove the hazard class entirely at the cost of a one-time normalization of those 50 files. dp's call; no longer urgent. RE-PRICED 2026-08-30 (interactive maintenance pass, measured not argued): the sentence 'a local build is no longer expected to churn' is FALSE as stated. A local `make-md.sh` in the shared /mnt/c checkout produced a 12,074-line `git diff` across the two mirrored monoliths (6,037 lines each) with ZERO content change -- `git diff --ignore-cr-at-eol` is empty and the normalized bytes compare equal. The 07-27 fix closed the SOURCE-side lone-CR bug and that half holds (loneCR=0 on both the committed blob and the rebuild); what it did not close is the ARTIFACT churn, and that is the half that costs a pass -- it makes `git add` after a rebuild unsafe and makes rebuild-and-diff unreadable without --ignore-cr-at-eol. The 50-of-95 figure reproduces exactly, no .gitattributes exists, and the committed artifact is itself a MIXTURE (616 CRLF lines against a rebuild's 4,457), so neither side is clean. The 'no longer urgent' downgrade rests on a claim that is false as stated; the filed `*.md text eol=lf` remedy is worth re-pricing. Still dp's call -- recorded, not executed.
